name: The Long-Suffering Conductor
description:
Who can handle the wild, untamed power of the Astral Express!? Pom-Pom, now beyond control, has transformed into Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom.
King Pom-Pom is a powerful mechatron obsessed with cleanliness and order. By its standards, this place is a mess and needs a thorough! Deep! Clean!

skills.name: Soulmend Shears
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: High-Temp Sterilization Mode
skills.description: Enters the "Steam Wash" state, increasing DMG dealt by this unit, and gains a set number of "Lasting Antibac" stacks, reducing the DMG this unit receives. When all stacks of "Lasting Antibac" are removed, exits the "Steam Wash" state and receives massive DMG.

skills.name: Zero-Blind-Spot Cleanse
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets and grants the target team <u>Punchline</u>.

skills.name: Potent Foam Soap
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets and applies the "<u>Work Is Bliss!</u>" effect, while causing the target team to gain <u>Punchline</u>.

skills.name: Duty Prep in Progress...
skills.description: Enters the "Raring to Go" state and gains the "Weakness Protected" effect. Uses "Saturation Cleaning!" in the next action.

skills.name: Saturation Cleaning!
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets and grants the target team <u>Punchline</u>.

skills.name: Scrubber's Mutiny
skills.description: At the start of each phase, the "Venue Protocol Enforcer" summons reinforcements for both sides. Each time an ally gains 1 Punchline, the ally's "Alloy Pommy" accumulates 1 Charge. Upon reaching <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Charge, it can use Enhanced Basic ATK to remove 1 stack of the "Lasting Antibac" effect from "The Long-Suffering Conductor" and ignore the "Weakness Protected" effect to forcibly reduce Toughness. A maximum of 1 ally "Alloy Pommy" can exist, and it cannot be targeted by either side.

skills.name: Innovative Bleach
skills.description: While "Daybreak Squadron" is in the "Daybreak Forcefield" state, "The Long-Suffering Conductor" gains a "Damage Immunity" effect of the same Type as that "Daybreak Squadron" member, while also gaining the "Weakness Protected" effect. When any "Daybreak Squadron" member is defeated by an ally target, the target "Alloy Pommy" immediately gains 1 extra turn, during which it can use its Enhanced Basic ATK.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is Broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Peak Friendship
tags.description: When "Daybreak Squadron" is summoned, it immediately uses "Daybreak Will" to enter the "Daybreak Forcefield" state. While "Daybreak Squadron" is in the "Daybreak Forcefield" state, the Boss Mirage gains a <color=#f29e38ff>"Damage Immunity"</color> effect of the same Type as that "Daybreak Squadron" member, and gains the <color=#f29e38ff>"Weakness Protected"</color> effect.

tags.name: Mountainous Poise
tags.description: The required attack count for "Daybreak Squadron" to exit "Daybreak Forcefield" increases.

tags.name: Indestructible
tags.description: While "Daybreak Squadron" is in the "Daybreak Forcefield" state, DMG taken is greatly reduced.

phases.description: When "Daybreak Squadron" is summoned, it immediately uses "Daybreak Will" to enter the "Daybreak Forcefield" state. While "Daybreak Squadron" is in the "Daybreak Forcefield" state, the Boss Mirage gains a <color=#f29e38ff>"Damage Immunity"</color> effect of the same Type as that "Daybreak Squadron" member, and gains the <color=#f29e38ff>"Weakness Protected"</color> effect.
phases.answer: Strategy: Dealing <color=#f29e38ff>Elation DMG</color> allows "Daybreak Squadron" to exit the "Daybreak Forcefield" state faster.

skills.name: How to Efficiently Reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness

texts.description: The ally Alloy Pommy's Enhanced Basic ATK can ignore Boss Mirage's "Weakness Protected" effect and forcibly reduce Toughness. Gaining Punchline grants the ally Alloy Pommy more extra turns in which it can use Enhanced Basic ATK.

skills.name: How to dispel the Boss Mirage's "Damage Immunity"

texts.description: Dealing Elation DMG can more quickly dispel the "Daybreak Squadron's" "Daybreak Forcefield" and the "Boss Mirage's" "Damage Immunity" effect.

guides.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is Broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

When "Daybreak Squadron" is summoned, it immediately uses "Daybreak Will" to enter the "Daybreak Forcefield" state. While "Daybreak Squadron" is in the "Daybreak Forcefield" state, the Boss Mirage gains a <color=#f29e38ff>"Damage Immunity"</color> effect of the same Type as that "Daybreak Squadron" member, and gains the <color=#f29e38ff>"Weakness Protected"</color> effect. Dealing <color=#f29e38ff>Elation DMG</color> allows "Daybreak Squadron" to exit the "Daybreak Forcefield" state faster.

When any "Daybreak Squadron" member is defeated by an ally target, the allied "Alloy Pommy" immediately gains 1 extra turn to use its Enhanced Basic ATK. When the allied "Alloy Pommy" uses its Enhanced Basic ATK on the Boss Mirage, it can <color=#f29e38ff>ignore its "Weakness Protected"</color> effect and forcefully reduce its Toughness.

texts.description: <color=#f29e38ff>Gaining Punchline</color> can accelerate charging of the ally "Alloy Pommy." The ally "Alloy Pommy's" Enhanced Basic ATK can dispel Boss Mirage's DMG Mitigation effect and reduce its Toughness.
Dealing <color=#f29e38ff>Elation DMG</color> allows "Daybreak Squadron" to exit the "Daybreak Forcefield" state faster.
Defeating any <color=#f29e38ff>"Daybreak Squadron"</color> member immediately grants the target "Alloy Pommy" 1 extra turn to use Enhanced Basic ATK.
